51480073.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to SARS-CoV-2 3CL protease at 1.875 to 50 uM by SPR assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: SPR Assay of Compounds. The binding affinity of compounds 3 and 4 and baicalein for 3CLpro was analyzed using a Biacore S200 system (GE Healthcare). Briefly, 100 μg of 3CLpro was immobilized on a CM5 sensor chip using a pH = 4.0 acetic acid solution. Compounds 3 and 4 and baicalein at different concentrations (50, 40, 30, 15, 7.5, 3.75, and 1.875 μM) were injected for 120 s at a flow rate of 40 μL/min. A cleaning solution of PBS with 50% DMSO was used to regenerate the CM5 chip. All response values were collected at 25 °C. Biacore Evaluation Software 2.0 was used to generate Kd values.
original_paragraph.Figure 5 caption: Figure 5. Activities of 1–4 against SARS-CoV-2. (A) The % inhibition of SARS-CoV-2 was measured at a final concentration of 10 μM (n = 3, independent experiments). (B) Vero E6 cells at an MOI of 0.01 were infected with SARS-CoV-2 and treated with a series of concentrations of the indicated antivirals for 24 h p.i. (n = 3). (C) Calu-3 cells were infected with SARS-CoV-2 at an MOI of 0.05 and treated with different doses of the indicated antivirals for 24 h p.i. (n = 3). (D) Representative inhibition curves for baicalein, a mixture of compounds 3 and 4, and pure 3 and 4 against 3CLpro (n = 3). (E–H) Affinities of mixed 3 and 4, pure 3 and 4, and baicalein for 3CLpro analyzed using an SPR assay.
original_paragraph.Figure 5E-H: Figure 5E-H shows sensorgrams for the SPR assay. The x-axis (time) ranges from 0 to 300 seconds. The y-axis (response) is in R.U. (Response Units). The legend indicates the concentrations used: 50 μM, 40 μM, 30 μM, 15 μM, 7.5 μM, 3.75 μM, and 1.875 μM. The sensorgrams for compounds 3 and 4 (Figures 5E and 5F) and baicalein (Figure 5H) show association (increasing response) and dissociation (decreasing response) phases. The concentration of 1.875 μM is explicitly labeled on the legend for all three sensorgrams (E, F, H).
